title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-2026-04-22
content:
Release Train Weekly Prep - 2026-04-22
Owner: Nadia Hussain (release lead)
Location: Weekly sync (Zoom) 2026-04-22 10:00 PT
Attendees: Samir, Arjun, Leah, Nadia, QA leads (optional)

Purpose: quick go/no-go readiness check for next week's minor launch (v1.12). Capture blockers, confirm owners, and surface decisions that need escalation. Keep this terse - action-focused.

AGENDA (15-20m)
- Quick status by area (infra, runtime, product, QA, docs) - 1-2 bullets each
- Go/No-Go checklist review (key gates)
- Blockers / risks -> owners + mitigation plan
- Decisions needed / escalations
- Actions and owners (assign + due date)

CURRENT HIGH-LEVEL STATUS (notes to self)
- Infra (Samir): Dedicated infra config validated on staging; one intermittent pod OOM observed with long batch jobs. Mitigation: reduce batch size for canary traffic.
- Serving runtime (Arjun): New KV cache tuning landed in feature branch; benchmarking shows 8-12% lower p99 for chat workloads. Need one more run with longer sequences (>2k tokens).
- QA: Regression suite 85% green; failing tests concentrated on tokenization edge cases and streaming timeouts.
- Product/docs: Release notes draft ready; API CHANGE log needs final confirmation about header behavior (X-Request-Trace).

GO / NO-GO CHECKLIST (core gates)
- Critical test pass (smoke + regression): QA indicates 85% green -> STATUS: at risk (owner: Leah Park)
- Security review sign-off: completed (owner: Security - done)
- Infra capacity validation for projected peak: staging validated, need one more scale test (owner: Samir)
- Rollback plan and Canary config: documented and tested on staging (owner: Arjun)
- Telemetry & alerting for rollout: dashboards created, alert thresholds TBD (owner: Nadia)
- Docs & API changes published: draft done, need final approval (owner: Product)

CURRENT DECISION RISK -> my notes
- If regression green % < 90% on final run tomorrow, default to hold and focus on tokenization fixes. Need confirm with Product and Head of SRE.
- Streaming timeout failures: root cause likely a transient handler locking bug; if fix not validated by Friday EOD, plan rollback of streaming changes for launch.

BLOCKERS (top priority)
1) Tokenization edge-case causing 2 failing end-to-end tests (owner: Leah Park) -> impact: user-visible truncation in certain unicode sequences. ETA fix + test: 2026-04-23 18:00 PT. Contingency: revert tokenizer patch if unresolved by 2026-04-24 morning.
2) Intermittent OOM in long-batch job on dedicated nodes (owner: Samir Patel) -> mitigation: reduce batch size for canary and apply resource guard. Capacity test scheduled 2026-04-22 16:00 PT.
3) Streaming timeout in chat toolchain (owner: Arjun Mehta) -> in-progress fix; need one full regression run with streaming enabled. If fail, rollback streaming feature for rollout.

DECISIONS NEEDED (escalation items)
- Decision A: Threshold for 'safe to release' - do we accept 90% regression pass or require 95%? (Recommend: 92% as compromise for this minor release)
- Decision B: If streaming fix not validated by EOD Friday, do we proceed without streaming changes? (Recommend: proceed without streaming changes; shipping other improvements preferred)

ACTION ITEMS (assign, due)
- Leah: prioritize tokenization fix + add regression test for unicode edge case. Due 2026-04-23 18:00 PT.
- Samir: run full-scale capacity test (with reduced batch size), confirm no OOMs. Due 2026-04-22 18:30 PT.
- Arjun: finalize KV cache benchmark with long sequences + validate streaming fix in staging. Due 2026-04-23 12:00 PT.
- Nadia: finalize alert thresholds and add rollout dashboard links to release doc. Due 2026-04-23 10:00 PT.
- Product: confirm API header behavior (X-Request-Trace) and publish final API CHANGE log. Due 2026-04-23 09:00 PT.
- QA team: run full regression with current fixes and post results in JIRA ticket JIRA-RT-542. Due 2026-04-23 20:00 PT.

NOTES / CHATTY SCRATCHES
- If Leah's fix takes longer, we should prep communication for hold scenario (bullet points for PM + eng comms) - TODO draft.
- Consider toggling streaming feature flag per-region during canary to limit blast radius.
- Reminder: update canary percent and ramp schedule in rollout config after we get final pass.

MEETING PREP (what to bring to sync)
- Short status line per area (30-60s each)
- Confirm blockers and show go/no-go recommendation (green/yellow/red)
- Bring concrete ask for escalations (if any)

QUICK DECISION LOG (to capture in meeting)
- If agreed: set release status to HOLD and reconvene 2026-04-24 09:30 PT for re-check.
- If go: initiate canary at 10% with streaming toggled off for 48h, monitor p99 and error rates closely.

FOLLOW-UPS (after meeting)
- Nadia to post meeting notes + updated checklist to Confluence (CONFLUENCE-RT-1024) and link to JIRA-RT-542.
- Owners to update their tickets with progress and ETA.

---
Personal notes: keep this doc short and copy final checklist into release plan PR. If anything ambiguous, ping me directly (Slack @nadia).
